You are repeating the text about transfers and fees. 

Instant transfers between Ledgerly Bank accounts cannot be cancelled once confirmed [1]. A scheduled transfer can be cancelled from the app until 11:59 PM on the day before its execution date. To recall an international transfer that has already been sent, the customer must contact the call centre. A recall is not guaranteed and a recall fee of AED 50 applies [1].

Customers can add up to 100 beneficiaries [2]. Adding a beneficiary requires OTP confirmation. The IBAN of a UAE beneficiary must start with "AE" and contain 23 characters.

Transfers between two Ledgerly Bank accounts are free of charge [3]. Local transfers to other UAE banks cost AED 2 per transfer when made through the mobile app or online banking, and AED 10 when requested at a branch [3]. International transfers (SWIFT) cost AED 30 per transfer. Correspondent bank charges may be deducted by intermediary banks and are outside Ledgerly Bank's control [3].

The default daily limit for transfers through the mobile app and online banking is AED 50,000 per customer, across all accounts [4]. Customers can raise the daily limit up to AED 250,000 from the app under Settings > Limits. Any increase requires one-time-password (OTP) confirmation, and the new limit becomes active after a 12-hour cooling-off period [4]. Transfers to a newly added beneficiary are limited to AED 10,000 during the first 24 hours after the beneficiary is added [4].
